evidence.name: MultiPhaseProcessingStateMachine

function_ir.summary: Time-sliced three-phase state machine that processes vehicle wheel data across multiple frames. Computes a target grip-derived value v9 = 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 and enters the processing path when the stored float at this+0x170 differs from v9 beyond tolerance or the index at this+0x174 is not the idle sentinel -1. Each call processes a batch of at most 20 wheels: phase selector this+0x16C == 0 runs friction callback sub_4FB260(v9), == 1 runs suspension callback sub_4FAF60, == 2 runs VehicleProximity; the phase index advances in this+0x174 and a phase transition occurs only when a batch reaches the wheel count at this+0x130. When all wheels are done the machine returns to phase 0 with index -1 (idle).

operations.description: Compute target value v9 = 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 from two global grip terms.
Enter processing if |float(this+0x170) - v9| > 0.05 or this+0x174 != -1; -1 is the idle sentinel for the phase index.
Re-initialize the machine when idle: set this+0x174 = 0, store v9 into float(this+0x170), and set phase selector this+0x16C = 0.
Compute batch end bound v3 = min(this+0x174 + 20, wheel count at this+0x130).
Dispatch on phase selector this+0x16C: 0 = friction, 1 = suspension, 2 = proximity.
Phase 0: for each wheel index in [this+0x174, v3) call sub_4FB260(v9) and advance this+0x174.
Phase 0 completion: when v3 reaches this+0x130, set this+0x16C = 1 and reset this+0x174 = 0.
Phase 1: for each wheel index in [this+0x174, v3) call sub_4FAF60 on wheel array base this+0x134 + 316 * index and advance this+0x174.
Phase 1 completion: when v3 reaches this+0x130, set this+0x174 = 0 and this+0x16C = 2.
Phase 2: for each wheel index in [this+0x174, v3) call VehicleProximity on wheel array base this+0x134 + 316 * index and advance this+0x174.
Phase 2 completion: when v3 reaches this+0x130, set this+0x16C = 0 and this+0x174 = -1, returning the machine to idle.
Invoked from the frame/main-loop paths GamePostMainLoop (0x0042D8A0) and StateTriggerCheck (0x004B8AE0).

unresolved: The float at this+0x170 is written with v9 and compared to v9 with a 0.05 tolerance, but its exact meaning (a per-run target grip derived from flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) is not confirmed; existing analysis prose called 0x170 an index, which conflicts with the raw float access.
The wheel array element type at base this+0x134 (stride 316) is not confirmed here; sub_4FAF60 and VehicleProximity are treated as suspension and proximity callbacks from existing analysis only.
Globals flt_59E43C, flt_59E450 and dbl_59E480 are listed in the packet globals but are not referenced by the raw source text of this function; their role is unclear.
The three callee names (friction/suspension/proximity) are DERIVED from existing analysis; only addresses are FACT.
